translations.web: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.
translations.bsb: Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even in the seasons of plowing and harvesting, you must rest.
translations.kjv: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
translations.asv: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in plowing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
